title: feat(marketplace): Your organization section — discover + install org packages (ADR-0007 ②)
body:
ADR-0007 **step ②** (frontend) — closes the original gap: a private/org package published by your org is now discoverable + installable from inside an environment's Marketplace.

- `listOrgPackages()` reads the same-origin `/api/v1/cloud-connection/org-packages` proxy.
- A **"Your organization"** section above the public catalog, with inline **Install** (reuses `installPackage` → `/cloud-connection/install`, env resolved by hostname). Already-installed packages show an **Installed** badge.
- Self-hosted/unbound → `connected:false` → section doesn't render.

Pairs with cloud #191. `tsc` clean for marketplace files. Will be activated in cloud via a `.objectui-sha` bump, then browser-verified on staging.
